description: This PHP class 'EndpointProviderV2' provides functionality to resolve service endpoints based on rulesets and input parameters, with caching support.

classes.name: EndpointProviderV2
classes.description: Provides endpoint resolution logic based on rulesets and request parameters, with caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a ruleset and partitions, setting up caching.

methods.name: getRuleset
methods.description: Returns the current Ruleset object used for endpoint evaluation.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate endpoint for the given input parameters, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: hashInputParameters
methods.description: Creates a hash key from input parameters for caching purposes.
